# quirc Source

The `quirc/` directory is vendored from Daniel Beer's official quirc repository:

- Release: `v1.2`
- Commit: `542848dd6b9b0eaa9587bbf25b9bc67bd8a71fca`
- Source: https://github.com/dlbeer/quirc

The application performs the mirrored-cell retry after a normal decode fails.
This matches the recovery behavior used by the working ESP32-CAM firmware.
